description: Prompts the MiniMax-M3 chat template renders for chat requests as a client sends them (MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3 at revision f0e1c1e04d40177e4673a22097036854f536e9c0: chat_template.jinja, the copy beside this file, rendered by the reference implementation with add_generation_prompt and every string content handed over as a one-item text part list, the way the engine's own server feeds this template; the plain-string rendering is identical). `ids` is the text's encoding with the checkpoint's tokenizer.json without added special tokens. The `root` cases are the shapes the template's role mapping distinguishes: a leading root message fills its high-priority system slot and a system or developer message right after it fills the developer slot. The two-root case carries `rendered_from`, the list the gateway renders after merging the roots into one leading root (texts joined by a blank line); the template on its own reads only the first message as the root.
